description: 6-Person Cube-Series Outdoor Home Sauna Kit CL7G Indulge in the ultimate relaxation with the SaunaLife Cube-Series Model CL7G outdoor home sauna kit. Designed for those who appreciate luxury and functionality, this sauna promises an unparalleled experience in your backyard. Exquisite Modern Design: Scandinavian Aesthetics: The Cube-Series boasts a sleek, modern Scandinavian design that enhances any outdoor setting. Its clean lines and minimalist style are a testament to high-end craftsmanship. Full-Glass Front: The striking full-glass front not only adds a touch of elegance but also provides a panoramic view of the surroundings, seamlessly blending indoor comfort with the beauty of nature. Spacious and Comfortable: Ample Room: With over 7 feet of height and a generous interior, the CL7G comfortably accommodates up to 6 bathers, making it perfect for gatherings with family and friends. Ergonomic Design: Thoughtfully designed for maximum comfort, the sauna includes ergonomic backrests and seating arrangements that support proper posture and relaxation. High-Quality Construction: Thermo-Spruce Exterior: The sauna features a beautiful and durable Thermo-Spruce exterior, known for its excellent heat resistance and longevity. This material not only ensures the sauna's durability but also gives it a natural, appealing look. Airflow Circulation: The construction supports optimal airflow circulation, ensuring a consistent and pleasant sauna experience by maintaining ideal temperature and humidity levels. Enhanced Features: Ergonomic Backrests: Enjoy additional comfort with specially designed backrests that provide support and enhance the overall relaxation experience. Group Enjoyment: The large space is perfect for socializing, allowing you to share the health benefits and relaxation of sauna bathing with your entire group. The SaunaLife Cube-Series Model CL7G is more than just a sauna; it's a statement piece that combines luxury, design, and functionality. Transform your outdoor space into a serene retreat and experience the timeless tradition of sauna bathing with this exquisite kit. The CL7G Black includes outdoor black paint for customer application after delivery. The paint is recommended to be reapplied annually as needed to maintain the finish. Applying the paint after delivery allows for a smooth, even finish and helps avoid scratches or nicks that can occur during LTL freight shipping. If your item(s) are available for immediate shipment (within 5 business days), we will process the charges and submit the order for shipment. When will my order ship? If your order is in stock and we process the charges to your credit card, it will ship within five business days from the date of your order. If you do not receive tracking information from us within six business days of your order, feel free to follow up with us at customercare@nordicasauna.com . No shipping outside the lower 48 States in the USA. What if my shipment is damaged? Please inspect the packaging of your item(s) when they arrive. If your item(s) do arrive damaged please send photos to customercare@nordicasauna.com and we will process an insurance claim on your behalf. Your warranty will guarantee you a fully functional and operational product. If it is unclear whether your order is custom or made to order, please message or call us. If you are replacing the product with something else, we may be able to help you cover some of the costs depending on the product.
